prompt: Prepare a diet plan for a 23 year old man. Diet type: Indian, Target Weight: 75kg
response: For a 23-year-old man aiming for a target weight of 75kg, an Indian diet plan can be structured to meet his nutritional needs. Start with a balanced breakfast of idli and sambar, followed by a protein-rich lunch of dal and rice. Dinner can consist of a mix of vegetables and roti. Include a daily intake of 3-4 servings of fruits and vegetables, and ensure adequate hydration. Incorporate regular physical activity to support weight management.
